```{r setup}
devtools::load_all()
#library(FADN2Footprint)

```

# Purpose

This report compares the outputs of `FADN2Footprint` (v`r packageVersion("FADN2Footprint")`)
against the raw FADN data.
An estimate is flagged **in range** if it falls within the literature min–max,
**within tolerance** if the relative deviation from the literature midpoint is
below a per-indicator threshold, or **out of range** otherwise.

# Load raw FADN data

```{r load_raw_FADN_data}
load(paste0(wd_path, "/data_raw/raw_FADN_EU_17_21.RData"))

  dplyr::mutate(ID = as.character(ID), YEAR = as.character(YEAR))
rm(my_FADN_data)
```

# Livestock population ----

First we compare the estimate between different Qobs equations

```{r Qobs_estimates}
  # no ALU, CN, nor ON variable in LAMASUS data so I load LIFT data
  load(paste0(wd_path, "/data_raw/FADN_EU_16_18.RData"))

  raw_pop <- FADN_16_18 |>
    dplyr::mutate(ID = as.character(ID), YEAR = as.character(YEAR)) |>
    dplyr::select(
      ID,
      COUNTRY,
      YEAR,
      SYS02,
      dplyr::matches("^L") & dplyr::matches("_AN$|_ALU$|_CN$|_ON$")
    ) |>
    # Pivot longer to handle all herd variables at once
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -c("ID", "COUNTRY", "YEAR", "SYS02"),
      names_to = "raw_variable",
      values_to = "value"
    ) |>
    # keep only variable with observed values
    dplyr::filter(value > 0) |>
    # Remove the suffix from the raw variable names
    dplyr::mutate(
      FADN_code_letter = sub("_AN$|_ALU$|_CN$|_ON$", "", raw_variable),
      pop_var = stringr::str_extract(raw_variable, "AN$|ALU$|CN$|ON$")
    ) |>
    # remove LTOT
    dplyr::filter(!grepl("LTOT", FADN_code_letter)) |>
    # pivot variables
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c("ID", "COUNTRY", "YEAR", "SYS02", "FADN_code_letter"),
      names_from = pop_var,
      values_from = value
    ) |>
    # add livestock unit coefficients
    dplyr::left_join(
      data_extra$livestock |>
        dplyr::select(FADN_code_letter, livestock_unit_coef),
      by = "FADN_code_letter"
    ) |>
    # Calculate ALU where missing
    dplyr::mutate(
      ALU = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(ALU) & !is.na(AN),
        AN * livestock_unit_coef,
        ALU
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      temp_alu_calc = ALU / livestock_unit_coef
    ) |>
    # Calculate Qobs (Observed Quantity of animals in number of head)
    dplyr::mutate(
      Qobs_AN = rowMeans(
        #cbind(AN,temp_alu_calc, ON, CN),
        cbind(AN, temp_alu_calc),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Qobs_CN_ON = rowMeans(
        cbind(AN, temp_alu_calc, ON, CN),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      raw_pop = Qobs_AN
    )

  # scatterplot comparison of livestock population between Qobs estimates
  raw_pop |>
    dplyr::filter(
      FADN_code_letter %in%
        data_extra$livestock$FADN_code_letter[
          data_extra$livestock$species %in% c("cattle", "swine", "poultry")
        ]
    ) |>
    ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::aes(x = Qobs_AN, y = Qobs_CN_ON) +
    #ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    ggplot2::geom_point(aes(color = COUNTRY, shape = factor(YEAR))) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("palettesForR::Tango") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Comparison of Livestock Population between Qobs estimates",
      x = "Qobs from AN and computed ALU",
      y = "Qobs from AN, computed ALU, ON, and CN",
      color = "Country",
      shape = "Year"
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~FADN_code_letter, scales = "free") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()

  rm(FADN_16_18)

```

There is no huge differences between estimates. As there is no ALU, CN nor ON variable in LAMASUS data, I'll keep the calculation from AN and computed ALU.

We compare raw FADN and F2F output for livestock population.

# Poultry farms ----

We loose a lot the poultry population in the F2F output compared to the raw FADN data.
We will investigate the reasons behind this discrepancy and identify potential issues in the F2F output for poultry population by looking in the raw data at farms with a lot of poultry that were discarded in the F2F processing.

```{r discarded_poultry_farm}

raw_poultry_farms <- raw_pop |>
  # add species
  #dplyr::left_join(
  #  data_extra$livestock |>
  #    dplyr::select(
  #      FADN_code_letter,
  #      species
  #    ),
  #  by = c("FADN_code_letter")
  #) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_AN_poultry = sum(raw_pop[species == "poultry"], na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_AN_other = sum(raw_pop[species != "poultry"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = dplyr::all_of(id_cols)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(sum_AN_poultry > 0) |>
  # add discarded farms information
  dplyr::left_join(
    my_object_GHGE@traceability$discarded_farms,
    by = c(id_cols)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    kept_or_not = ifelse(is.na(problem), "kept", "discarded")
  )

table(raw_poultry_farms$kept_or_not)
#raw_poultry_farms |> view()

raw_poultry_farms |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(problem)) |>
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(cols = problem, delim = ";") |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(x = problem, fill = COUNTRY)
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_bar() +
  paletteer::scale_fill_paletteer_d("palettesForR::Tango") +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Discarded Poultry Farms by Problem",
    x = "Problem",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()

```

# Compare GE filters ----

```{r estimate_feed}


raw_th_ration <- f_feed_theo_ration(my_object)
raw_th_ration_sum_feed_DM <- raw_th_ration$th_feed_ration |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_DM_t_livcat = sum(th_DMI_t_livcat_y)
  )

raw_herd_feed <- f_herd_feed(my_object, overwrite = FALSE)

```

```{r apply_filters}


tmp_max_cat0 <- my_object@herd |>
  # estimate LU
  dplyr::mutate(
    LU = Qobs * livestock_unit_coef
  ) |>
  # filter max LU
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = LU,
    with_ties = FALSE,
    by = dplyr::all_of(id_cols)
  ) |>
  # select columns
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(id_cols), FADN_code_letter)

### Average FADN filter ----
tmp_mean_GE <- FADN_averages$GE_MJ_anim_day |>
  #dplyr::summarise(
  #     mean_GE_MJ_anim_day = mean(mean_GE_MJ_anim_day, na.rm = T),
  #     sd_GE_MJ_anim_day = mean(sd_GE_MJ_anim_day, na.rm = T),
  #     .by = FADN_code_letter
  #) |>
  # define thresholds
  dplyr::mutate(
    threshold_up = mean_GE_MJ_anim_day + 3 * sd_GE_MJ_anim_day,
    threshold_down = dplyr::case_when(
      FADN_code_letter == "LCOWDAIR" ~ 0.25 * mean_GE_MJ_anim_day,
      .default = 0.10 * mean_GE_MJ_anim_day
    )
  )

## main livestock category
tmp_max_cat <- tmp_max_cat0 |>
  # add thresholds
  dplyr::left_join(
    tmp_mean_GE,
    #by = 'FADN_code_letter'
    # TODO: restore by country when good enough data
    by = c('FADN_code_letter', 'COUNTRY')
  )

## retrieve farms with aberrant values
farms_to_remove_GE_filter_avrg_FADN <- raw_herd_feed$feed_intake$total |>
  # add thresholds and filter for the main livestock category
  dplyr::inner_join(
    tmp_max_cat,
    by = c(id_cols, 'FADN_code_letter')
  ) |>
  # filter farms above & below thresholds
  dplyr::mutate(
    valid_practice = dplyr::case_when(
      # between thresholds
      GE_MJ_anim / 365 >= threshold_down &
        GE_MJ_anim / 365 <= threshold_up ~ TRUE,
      # if NAs
      is.na(GE_MJ_anim) | is.na(threshold_down) | is.na(threshold_up) ~ FALSE,
      .default = FALSE
    )
  )

table(farms_to_remove_GE_filter_avrg_FADN$valid_practice)

### AROPAj filter ----

AROPAJ_Sailley_filter <- source(file.path(wd_path,"inst/scripts/AROPAJ_Sailley_filter_for_GE.R"))$value

tmp_mean_GE <- AROPAJ_Sailley_filter |>
  # add livestock unit coefficient
  dplyr::left_join(
    data_extra$livestock |>
      dplyr::select(FADN_code_letter, livestock_unit_coef),
    by = c('FADN_code_letter')
  ) |>
  # define thresholds
  dplyr::mutate(
    threshold_up = (th_GE_MJ_LU_y * livestock_unit_coef) * 10,
    threshold_down = dplyr::case_when(
      FADN_code_letter == "LCOWDAIR" ~ 0.25 *
        (th_GE_MJ_LU_y * livestock_unit_coef),
      .default = 0.10 * (th_GE_MJ_LU_y * livestock_unit_coef)
    )
  )

## main livestock category
tmp_max_cat <- tmp_max_cat0 |>
  # add thresholds
  dplyr::left_join(
    tmp_mean_GE,
    by = 'FADN_code_letter'
  )

## retrieve farms with aberrant values
```
